name_gender.label: Name / Perceived Gender
name_gender.rationale: Swaps only the candidate's displayed name, holding the surname constant across all 5 variations so the ethnicity signal does not change, isolating perceived-gender signal (Bertrand & Mullainathan 2004 resume-audit convention). Name detection is conservative: only a HIGH/MEDIUM-confidence match is replaced in place; otherwise a clearly labeled synthetic identity header is added and the (possibly unreliable) source text is left untouched. A pronoun-consistency check flags any variation whose assigned name gender signal conflicts with explicit he/him/his or she/her/hers pronouns found in the source.
name_gender.preserves: All experience, skills, education, dates, and achievements are untouched.

ethnicity.label: Perceived Ethnicity
ethnicity.rationale: Swaps the candidate's full name using a bank of names carrying different perceived racial/ethnic signal, holding first-name gender presentation constant (Bertrand & Mullainathan 2004; Gaddis 2017 name-signal literature). Uses the same conservative detection, synthetic-header fallback, and pronoun-consistency check as name_gender.
ethnicity.preserves: All experience, skills, education, dates, and achievements are untouched.

age.label: Age
age.rationale: Shifts a single, explicitly identified education-completion year to signal a different age cohort, following the graduation-year manipulation used in age-discrimination correspondence audits (Lahey 2008; Neumark, Burn & Button 2019). The anchor year is located by section-aware scanning that protects WORK EXPERIENCE / EXPERIENCE date ranges, certification dates, and project dates from any change, and only the single identified character span is replaced (never a global find-and-replace of that digit string). If no safe anchor can be found, a clearly delimited 'EDUCATION COMPLETION YEAR' block is appended instead of editing body text, and the variation is flagged REVIEW rather than silently passed.
age.preserves: All experience, skills, employer names, employment dates, certification dates, project dates, and achievements are untouched.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.rationale: Appends an explicit citizenship / work-authorization line, mirroring real resumes in this corpus that already state citizenship (e.g. federal-application resumes). Used to audit visa-sponsorship / national-origin signal without touching the CV body.
nationality.preserves: All experience, skills, education, and achievements are untouched.

education.label: Education (Institution Prestige Tier)
education.rationale: Swaps only the named institution (degree, field, GPA, and graduation year untouched), spanning elite-private to community-college/for-profit tiers, following institution-prestige audit designs (Rivera 2015; Deming et al.). If no institution pattern is found, a clearly delimited 'EDUCATION (INSTITUTION NOTE)' block is appended instead.
education.preserves: All experience, skills, degree, GPA, graduation year, and achievements are untouched.

writing_style.label: Writing Style
writing_style.rationale: Applies mechanical, fact-preserving presentation changes only (bullet vs. narrative, header casing/dividers, spacing density). Every alphanumeric word token is identical to the original; only whitespace/punctuation/layout changes.
writing_style.preserves: Every word in the resume; only formatting/layout changes.

variations.label: bullet_dense
variations.description: Every content line prefixed with '- ' (bulleted layout).

variations.label: narrative_dense
variations.description: Entire document collapsed into one continuous line of prose.

variations.label: formal_headers
variations.description: Section dividers wrapped with '=' rules (or a leading rule added).

variations.label: compact_spacing
variations.description: All blank-line gaps collapsed to single newlines (terse layout).

leadership_language.label: Leadership Language
leadership_language.rationale: Appends a one-line framing statement of varying leadership-language intensity (none to very high), consistent with the leadership-term density axis used for proxy analysis in this project's grouping scripts.
leadership_language.preserves: All experience, skills, education, and achievements are untouched.

variations.label: none
variations.text: (No additional leadership framing.)

variations.label: low
variations.text: Consistently supported team objectives and contributed reliably to assigned tasks.

variations.label: medium
variations.text: Coordinated cross-functional efforts and contributed to team decision-making.

variations.label: high
variations.text: Led and directed key initiatives, managing team priorities and outcomes.

variations.label: very_high
variations.text: Spearheaded strategic initiatives; mentored colleagues and drove organization-wide results as a recognized team leader.

resume_length.label: Resume Length
resume_length.rationale: Appends generic, non-factual administrative boilerplate ('references available', availability/logistics statements) of increasing size to vary total resume length without adding any new qualification, skill, or experience claims.
resume_length.preserves: All experience, skills, education, and achievements are untouched; no new facts are added.
